question: The difference between the simple interest and the compound interest on a certain amount at 9% per annum for two years is ₹162, what is the principal?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 2 years, the difference between CI and SI is calculated directly as: D = P × (R/100)²

⇒ 162 = P × (9/100)²

⇒ 162 = P × (81 ÷ 10000)

⇒ P = (162 × 10000) ÷ 81

⇒ P = 2 × 10000 = 20000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹20000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate (R) = 9% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

CI − SI = ₹162
